purpose: A primed ordinary public method Generator receives a temporary supplied Exception in catch, suspends with its receiver, yields a scalar recovery value, then retires the receiver at Generator completion.
source:
<?php
function Make63() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given63');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
class ScalarOwner63 {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER|'; }
    public function values() {
        global $weakGiven, $weakOwner;
        try {
            echo 'SEED|';
            yield 'seed63';
            echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
        } catch (Exception $caught) {
            echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
            Fiber::suspend('pause63');
            echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakOwner->get()), '|';
            yield 'after63';
            echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
        }
        return 63;
    }
}
function Run63Scalar() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make63());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after63'), '|';
    return 'fiber63';
}
$owner = new ScalarOwner63();
$weakOwner = WeakReference::create($owner);
$g = $owner->values();
unset($owner);
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed63'), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run63Scalar');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause63'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($g->current() === 'seed63'), '|',
     (int) ($weakOwner->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber63'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 63), '|',
     (int) ($weakOwner->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $error, $weakOwner, $weakGiven);
echo 'E';
